title: The request to start a run of each eval
description: The body of POST {RATEL_BASE_URL}/evals/runs (permission evals:write). It starts one run for each eval, or for each eval of `evals`. Each change applies to these runs only.

evals.description: The evals to run, by name or id. Absent: each eval of `sandbox`, else each eval of the project. An eval with no row or no gating scorer is left out (`skipped`). At most 100 items.

sandbox.description: The sandbox of the caller (the name of its ratel.yaml). It chooses the evals when `evals` is absent.

sandboxVersion.description: A version id, or `latest`. A version applies only to the evals of its sandbox: each other eval runs on its own runtime, and its part has a `note`. Absent: each eval runs on its own runtime (its pinned version, else the newest ready version of its sandbox).

dataset.description: Another dataset (name or id) for these runs.

rows.description: Rows of typed values that each run adds to the rows of its dataset. At most 500 items.

scorers.description: Other scorers of the library: {source: project, scorerId}, {source: predefined, key, value?}, with gating. At most 50 items.

params.description: Values that go over the default params of each eval.

matrix.description: For some params, a list of values. A run has one variant for each combination: at most 12 combinations, else 400 invalid_matrix.

trials.description: The trials of each row in each variant. Absent: the trials of each eval.

label.description: Only the rows of a fixed dataset with this label.
